rites.name: Miirora
rites.text: Miirora is the sounding-tone that the Singing gave shape to before the first roots of Coriarnes condensed, a note that holds the pattern the flame-temples later sought to name. In the Holy Age, its resonance was said to kindle the orders' hearth-fires and bind their oaths into the forming world.

rites.name: Vesyuthasha
rites.text: Vesyuthasha is the concept of threshold-keeping in Coriarnes, the idea that every door between worlds must be held open by a bargain and closed by a promise. In the Courts it is invoked by judges who weigh whether a passage may stand, and it appears wherever a grove or kingdom asks to grow past its borders.

rites.name: Valeoleror
rites.text: A learned tactic that lets its wielder fade from sight for a short span. It can be practiced and strengthened over time by a single gifted user.

rites.name: Tasia
rites.text: A passive art that strengthens its bearer, and the vital fluid of living creatures that a nightborn hunter must draw in order to keep existing.

rites.name: Amiallia
rites.text: A dark art of drawing a cloud of gloom around oneself, one of the active attacking techniques a wandering healer may learn over the course of his journey.

rites.name: Veollia
rites.text: A close-range strike that tears through every living creature standing directly before the wielder. It is taught as one of the sharpest techniques of the combat disciplines.

rites.name: Siallanor
rites.text: A tireless growth-system where a wanderer's inner strength swells during rest, and gains surge when a living subject is consumed. Stronger wielders deal heavier blows and suffer less, while weaker ones falter.

rites.name: Corintastum
rites.text: A quiet, constant discipline that steadies a wanderer's bodily vitality. Strengthening it lengthens how long the wanderer can endure before weakening.

rites.name: Corallium
rites.text: A surging inner fury that a wielder can awaken and sharpen over time. It ranks among the greatest abilities a person can master.

rites.name: Silium
rites.text: A reconciling bond formed between two kindred who choose to share a long journey together. Its spreading path seeks a remedy that would undo their shared affliction.

rites.name: Ceonentes
rites.text: A bearer can draw upon their own lifeblood to mend wounds of every kind almost at once. It is among the first talents a newly transformed creature gains.
